Name: Clint HD Portraits by Hemptress
Author: Hemptress
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Clint HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b] gives Pelican Town’s blacksmith a semi-realistic glow-up—pale blue eyes, copper hair, a luscious beard, and broad, muscular shoulders. The man swings a hammer for a living. Those shoulders were earned.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
This makeover gives Clint a slightly younger appearance, a stronger jawline, and a more forward-facing pose while keeping his recognizable vanilla outfits. Still your local blacksmith, just giving you another reason to visit when your tools are already upgraded.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Let’s get your upgraded blacksmith into the game. 🖤
[/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture by Platonymous[/url], using versions compatible with your game.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip [b]Clint HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Open
[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/[/code][color=#D4D4D8]and create a folder named [b]Hemptress Clint[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place both portrait PNGs directly inside that folder with these filenames:[/color][/*]
[/list][table][tr][th][color=#D4D4D8]Portrait[/color][/th]
[th][color=#D4D4D8]Filename[/color][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Everyday portraits[/color][/td]
[td][code]Clint.png[/code][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Beach portraits[/color][/td]
[td][code]Clint_IslandSouth.png[/code][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][color=#D4D4D8]Your files should be located here:
[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Hemptress Clint/Clint.png
Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Hemptress Clint/Clint_IslandSouth.png[/code][list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through [b]SMAPI[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Talk to Clint and press [b]P[/b] while his dialogue box is open until [b]Hemptress Clint[/b] is selected.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Press [b]O[/b] during his dialogue to lock this portrait set to Clint if you’re using different packs for other characters.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Now go find an excuse to crack some geodes. ♡[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Everyday HD portraits[/b] with expressive faces and his familiar work clothes.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Matching beach portraits[/b], because even the blacksmith deserves a day off.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Pale blue eyes, detailed copper hair, and a full beard.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]A broader, muscular build[/b] with defined, masculine features.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]A polished semi-realistic style[/b] to bring a little extra eye candy to your farm life.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]For anyone who’s ever looked at Clint and thought, [i]there’s potential under that apron[/i].[/color]
